name: std::map<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::rbegin, std::map<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::crbegin
intro: Returns a reverse iterator to the first element of the reversed map. It corresponds to the last element of the non-reversed map. If the map is empty, the returned iterator is equal to rend().

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Reverse iterator to the first element.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
The underlying iterator of the returned reverse iterator is the end iterator. Hence the returned iterator is invalidated if and when the end iterator is invalidated.

libc++ backports crbegin() to C++98 mode.
